headline: NY Session Open - Volatility Expected
summary: The New York session has opened. Early liquidity sweeps are common in the first 30 minutes.
evidence_packets: Orderbook is thickening around major liquidity pools.
confirmation_needed: Wait for the initial 15-minute candle to close before assessing direction.
invalidation: Immediate strong trend without a sweep invalidates the standard open playbook.
retail_translation: The market just opened and might be erratic. Don't jump in immediately.
